# I know this looks autogenerated, but it's not (:
message(STATUS "CMakeLists.txt in app/")

# Sources under cluster3D/ are the validation and diagnostic tools for the
# src/Cluster3D space-point pipeline (see cluster3D/README.md). They are
# listed here by path rather than through a sub-CMakeLists so their binaries
# stay in build/app/ alongside everything else.

add_executable(BField_tester BField_tester.cpp)
add_executable(BetheBloch_Example BetheBloch_Example.cpp)
add_executable(CherryPickEvents CherryPickEvents.cpp)
add_executable(ConvertToTMSTree ConvertToTMSTree.cpp)
add_executable(DrawEvents DrawEvents.cpp)
add_executable(ShootRay ShootRay.cpp)
add_executable(TrackLengthTester TrackLengthTester.cpp)
add_executable(DBSCAN_test DBSCAN_test.cpp)
add_executable(RealDataSmokeTest RealDataSmokeTest.cpp)
add_executable(SpacePointCluster_test cluster3D/SpacePointCluster_test.cpp)
add_executable(RealEventClusterDisplay cluster3D/RealEventClusterDisplay.cpp)
add_executable(SpillClusterDisplay cluster3D/SpillClusterDisplay.cpp)
add_executable(ClusterTruthEfficiency cluster3D/ClusterTruthEfficiency.cpp)
add_executable(DumpHitPE cluster3D/DumpHitPE.cpp)
add_executable(GraphTrackFinder_test cluster3D/GraphTrackFinder_test.cpp)
add_executable(GraphTrackFinderSliceTest cluster3D/GraphTrackFinderSliceTest.cpp)
add_executable(GraphTrackFinderSweep cluster3D/GraphTrackFinderSweep.cpp)
add_executable(GraphTrackFinderTruthEfficiency cluster3D/GraphTrackFinderTruthEfficiency.cpp)
add_executable(KalmanFollowerSliceTest cluster3D/KalmanFollowerSliceTest.cpp)
add_executable(KalmanFollowerTruthEfficiency cluster3D/KalmanFollowerTruthEfficiency.cpp)
add_executable(TrackFindingObjectTruth cluster3D/TrackFindingObjectTruth.cpp)
add_executable(DumpTrueTrajectory cluster3D/DumpTrueTrajectory.cpp)

target_link_libraries(BField_tester LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod ROOT::EG)
target_link_libraries(BetheBloch_Example LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(CherryPickEvents LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(ConvertToTMSTree LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(DrawEvents LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(ShootRay LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(TrackLengthTester LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(DBSCAN_test LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(RealDataSmokeTest LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(SpacePointCluster_test LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(RealEventClusterDisplay LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(SpillClusterDisplay LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(ClusterTruthEfficiency LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(DumpHitPE LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(GraphTrackFinder_test LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(GraphTrackFinderSliceTest LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(GraphTrackFinderSweep LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(GraphTrackFinderTruthEfficiency LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(KalmanFollowerSliceTest LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(KalmanFollowerTruthEfficiency LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
target_link_libraries(TrackFindingObjectTruth LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod)
# TMS_Prod pulls in ROOT's libImt, which needs libtbb symbols that ROOT_LIBRARIES
# doesn't itself link -- LD_LIBRARY_PATH finds the .so at runtime but the linker
# needs it explicitly at link time. Only DrawEvents/DumpTrueTrajectory actually
# hit this (they construct TMS_Event from a real TG4Event); the other apps here
# never trip the code path that needs it.
find_library(TBB_LIBRARY NAMES tbb)
target_link_libraries(DumpTrueTrajectory LINK_PUBLIC TMS_Prod ${TBB_LIBRARY})

install(TARGETS BField_tester RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS BetheBloch_Example RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS CherryPickEvents RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS ConvertToTMSTree RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS DrawEvents RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS ShootRay RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS TrackLengthTester RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS DBSCAN_test RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS RealDataSmokeTest RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS SpacePointCluster_test RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS RealEventClusterDisplay RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS SpillClusterDisplay RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS ClusterTruthEfficiency RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS DumpHitPE RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS GraphTrackFinder_test RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS GraphTrackFinderSliceTest RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS GraphTrackFinderSweep RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS GraphTrackFinderTruthEfficiency RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS KalmanFollowerSliceTest RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS KalmanFollowerTruthEfficiency RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS TrackFindingObjectTruth RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS DumpTrueTrajectory RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
